metas.name: Kagurabachi
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

metas.name: Youchien WARS
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Romance Welcome to Kindergarten Noir, an exclusive school catering to children of the global elite. Rita, one of the teachers, has been on the hunt for a boyfriend but has had absolutely zero luck so far. One day, an assassin comes after one of the children...and he’s totally dreamy?! Dive into this action-packed rom-com as it unfolds inside the world’s “safest” kindergarten!

(Source: MANGA PLUS)

metas.name: LONA
metas.description:
Genres: Sci-Fi A broken world in the not-so distant future.
Humanity is facing a new incident.

"We’re being attacked by humans who should be dead."

The government has decided to request a specialized organization to deal with this situation.
The Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis, commonly known as "LONA."
Researcher Ao and her apprentice Sango will try to get to the bottom of the mystery by analyzing the brains of the dead.

What do people think of, and what do they leave behind before they die?
Countless memories engraved in the neural circuits. What did they see in those deep depths?

(Source: LONA Official Site)

metas.name: Unmei no Makimodoshi
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Drama, Mystery, Sci-Fi The series follows Chrono, a 14-year-old boy who is a member of the Space-Time Police Special Forces Unit called the “Rewinders”. The organization uses its “Retry Eye” to save people who have already died, using future knowledge to repeatedly go back in time to get to a future where the victim is alive and well.

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

metas.name: Tenkaichi: Nihon Saikyou Bugeisha Ketteisen
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Fantasy This is not history as we know it. The year is 1600. Ten years have passed since Oda Nobunaga unified the whole of Japan. When Nobunaga realizes he is nearing the end of his life, he announces that he will hand over the reins of power to whoever brings him the strongest warrior. The generals, whose dreams of conquering the country had been crushed, put up their own strongest warriors and aim to become the king of the country!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

metas.name: Free Fire Daybreak
metas.description:
Genres: Action Set in the futuristic metropolis of New Dawn, Free Fire Daybreak follows protagonist Kelly, who awakens with no memory of her past and is drawn into Horizon Corporation's mysterious "Project Bloom".

(Source: Official Website)

metas.name: Shouzen
metas.description:
Genres: Slice of Life, Supernatural Douzen, a Taoist priest who travels the land, one day encounters a young girl raised by a yokai. Unfamiliar with human emotions or affection, Douzen gives her the name Shouzen and decides to take her along on his travels as his disciple. What is goodness? What is love? Thus begins a journey of spiritual training for Shouzen as she grows into a human being.

(Source: Fuji TV, translated)
